tips.label: 問天氣
tips.text: 用 How is/was the weather ...? 或 What is/was the weather like ...? 來問天氣。

tips.label: 回答天氣
tips.text: 用 It is/was + 天氣形容詞回答，例如 It was rainy. 注意這裡用 It，不用 This 或 That。

tips.label: 易混淆句型
tips.text: It snows/snowed 的 snow 是動詞；It is/was snowy 的 snowy 是形容詞。There is/was + rain/snow 與 We/They have/had + rain/snow 都能表示某地有雨雪，但主詞與動詞不可混搭。

notes.title: How 與 What 詢問天氣
notes.rule: How + be 動詞 + the weather + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？／What + be 動詞 + the weather + like + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？
notes.description: How 的問句不能加 like；What 的問句一定要加 like。be 動詞依時間改成 is 或 was。
examples: How is the weather in Taipei today?
What was the weather like in Hsinchu last night?
How was the weather in Australia in summer?

notes.title: 回答天氣狀況
notes.rule: It + is / was + 天氣形容詞。
notes.description: 談天氣時用代名詞 It 代替 the weather。今天、現在等現在時間用 is；昨天、上週等過去時間用 was。
examples: It was rainy and wet yesterday.

notes.title: 描述雨量與雪量
notes.rule: It + rains/rained/snows/snowed + a lot/a little + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這個句型是動詞；現在習慣或事實用 rains/snows，過去發生的事用 rained/snowed。snowy 是形容詞，必須搭配 It is/was snowy，後面不能再直接接 a lot 或 a little。
examples: It rains a lot in Taipei in winter.
It snowed a little in the mountains yesterday.

notes.title: There is/was 與 have 描述雨雪
notes.rule: There + is/was + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。／We/They + have + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這裡是不可數名詞，不能說 many rains。There 開頭要搭配 is/was；We/They 開頭要搭配 have/had。問句分別是 Is/Was there ...? 與 Do/Did we/they have ...?，兩套句型不可混搭。
examples: There was a lot of rain last summer.
We have much rain in spring.
They had a little snow in January.

quiz.question: ___ was the weather like when you visited the island?
quiz.hint: 問句有 like，詢問天氣要用 What was the weather like。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather outside at this moment?
quiz.hint: at this moment 表示現在，weather 搭配單數 is。

quiz.question: What was the weather ___ during the school festival?
quiz.hint: What was the weather like 是詢問天氣的句型，like 不作動詞變化。

quiz.question: ___ is the weather near the river today?
quiz.hint: 沒有 like 的天氣問句用 How is the weather。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather on your birthday last year?
quiz.hint: last year 表示過去，weather 搭配單數 was。

quiz.question: A: How is the weather on the island? B: ___ is warm and sunny.
quiz.hint: 描述天氣用 It 作主詞，再接 is 與天氣形容詞。

quiz.question: The fishermen stayed home yesterday because it ___ stormy.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，天氣主詞 it 搭配 was。

quiz.question: Look outside! It ___ very cloudy right now.
quiz.hint: right now 指現在；it 是單數，搭配 is。

quiz.question: It is usually ___ on the coast in autumn.
quiz.hint: be 動詞 is 後用天氣形容詞 windy 描述天氣。

quiz.question: It was ___ when the fisherman left the harbor.
quiz.hint: was 後用天氣形容詞 rainy，不能直接接 rain 的動詞變化。

quiz.question: It ___ almost every afternoon here in summer.
quiz.hint: every afternoon 表示習慣，主詞 it 的現在簡單式用 rains。

quiz.question: It ___ for three hours here yesterday morning.
quiz.hint: yesterday morning 表示過去，rain 用過去式 rained。

quiz.question: It often ___ in the village during the cold season.
quiz.hint: often 表示習慣，主詞 it 搭配現在簡單式 snows。

quiz.question: It ___ all night in the mountains last Saturday.
quiz.hint: last Saturday 表示過去，snow 用過去式 snowed。

quiz.question: Does it ___ a lot around the lake in June?
quiz.hint: 助動詞 does 後的主要動詞用原形 rain。

quiz.question: Did it ___ during your stay in Canada?
quiz.hint: 助動詞 did 已表示過去，後面用原形 snow。

quiz.question: It does not ___ very often in this dry area.
quiz.hint: does not 後接原形動詞 rain。

quiz.question: It did not ___ at all during our winter holiday.
quiz.hint: did not 後接原形 snow，不能再用過去式。

quiz.question: ___ it rain near the harbor every spring?
quiz.hint: 一般動詞 rain 的現在式問句，主詞 it 搭配 Does。

quiz.question: ___ it snow during the storm last night?
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去，一般動詞 snow 的問句用 Did。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of rain on this island every September.
quiz.hint: There 開頭描述雨量用 be 動詞，rain 是不可數名詞，搭配 is。

quiz.question: There ___ a little snow outside our cabin last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去，snow 是不可數名詞，There 後用 was。

quiz.question: We usually ___ a lot of rain during this season.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 用 have 描述當地雨量，不能套用 There is 的句型。

quiz.question: The island ___ very little rain last April.
quiz.hint: last April 表示過去，have 用過去式 had。

quiz.question: ___ there any snow near your hotel last week?
quiz.hint: There was 的疑問句把 Was 放句首，snow 是不可數名詞。

quiz.question: ___ there much rain in this area every autumn?
quiz.hint: There is 的疑問句把 Is 放句首，rain 是不可數名詞。

quiz.question: Did the island ___ much rain last winter?
quiz.hint: Did 後用原形 have，即使主詞 the island 是單數也不加 s。

quiz.question: Does your village ___ snow every winter?
quiz.hint: Does 後用原形 have，不能再用 has。

quiz.question: There was not ___ snow on the hill yesterday.
quiz.hint: snow 是不可數名詞，表示量多用 much，其他選項修飾可數名詞。

quiz.question: We had very ___ rain during our holiday.
quiz.hint: rain 是不可數名詞，very little 表示雨量很少。

quiz.question: There was a lot of ___ in the garden after the storm.
quiz.hint: a lot of 後接名詞；snow 在此是不可數名詞。

quiz.question: Our town has very little ___ in the dry season.
quiz.hint: little 後接不可數名詞 rain，不能接形容詞或動詞變化。

quiz.question: It ___ sunny at the farm yesterday, so we played outside.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，it 後接 was，再接形容詞 sunny。

quiz.question: It ___ heavily during our boat trip yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，此處需要動詞過去式 rained。

quiz.question: Our village usually ___ heavy snow in February.
quiz.hint: our village 是單數主詞，現在簡單式的 have 要改成 has。

quiz.question: The fishermen's town ___ no rain last month.
quiz.hint: last month 表示過去，描述當地雨量用 had。

quiz.question: We do not ___ much rain here in November.
quiz.hint: do not 後面用原形 have。

quiz.question: The island did not ___ any snow last year.
quiz.hint: did not 後面用原形 have。

quiz.question: A: Was it windy during the boat trip? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Was it，肯定簡答用 Yes, it was。

quiz.question: A: Is it rainy outside now? B: No, it ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Is it，否定簡答用 No, it isn't。

quiz.question: A: Did it snow at the farm yesterday? B: No, it ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Did，否定簡答也用 didn't。

quiz.question: A: Does it rain a lot in April? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Does，主詞 it 的肯定簡答用 does。

quiz.question: A: Was there any snow by the lake? B: No, there ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Was there，否定簡答用 there wasn't。

quiz.question: A: Did you have much rain on your trip? B: Yes, we ___.
quiz.hint: 以 Did 開頭的問句用助動詞 did 作肯定簡答。

quiz.question: A: Is there much rain here in May? B: Yes, there ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Is there，簡答用 there is。

quiz.question: A: Does this town have snow in winter? B: No, it ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Does，否定簡答用 doesn't，而不是 hasn't。

quiz.question: What ___ the weather like during the storm yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，weather 搭配單數 was。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather in your village these days?
quiz.hint: these days 表示這陣子，weather 是不可數名詞，搭配 is。

quiz.question: There ___ no rain here last weekend.
quiz.hint: There 開頭不能搭配 had；過去的不可數名詞 rain 搭配 was。

quiz.question: It is ___ in the mountains today, so wear a warm coat.
quiz.hint: is 後用形容詞 snowy 描述下雪的天氣。
